item.title: Show HN: Stuff to do this weekend in the Raleigh/Durham metro area
item.summary: I've been rebuilding my federated social media protocol, Jonline ( https://github.com/JonLatane/jonline ) for a while. Agents have really changed the game for what I can do with platform of mine, and this is one of the things I like the most. Among many things, they've made it very easy to make my Events platform an "ICS aggregator/repeater/router" of sorts. Eventually I'll post a blog post here about it. Plus, at the moment, it's a good demo of federation of events from my band's site ( https://ato.band ), since we happen to have 2 gigs this weekend :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49210388 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
